author: stefduponcheel
body:
#### PR description:

Follow-up to #52130, fixing a bug flagged by integration-build QA after that PR merged:  https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52130#issuecomment-6687391532.

The OT line in CondCore/SiPhase2TrackerPlugins/src/plugin.cc must use REGISTER_PLUGIN_NO_SERIAL like the IT line already does, to avoid a conflicting duplicate registration across the two plugin libraries.


#### PR validation:

- `cmssw` compiles 
- `scram b runtests_test_CondToolsSiPhase2Tracker` still passes after this change.
- Verified release-wide that `SiPixelQuality` is now registered via a full `REGISTER_PLUGIN` exactly once (in `CondCore/SiPixelPlugins`, where it already was), and that `CondCore/SiPhase2TrackerPlugins/src/plugin.cc` no longer registers it a second time.
- This directly addresses the duplicate-registration issue reported in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52130#issuecomment-6687391532.
title: Fix duplicate SiPixelQuality  registration in #52130
